The room's background blurs slightly due to depth of field. Warm amber tones dominate the scene. [English] "Me too," responds (S2), the man, his expression sincere. The camera tilts down with small amplitude at slow speed to capture the handshake. Warm light fills the frame. [Shot 3] 在 00:04.500 处，镜头切回一个略有不同角度的中全景，展示两人全身。女子微微一笑并伸出手。摄像机以小幅慢速向下倾斜，捕捉握手动作。暖光充满画面。[English] "It's good to see you," (S1) 说，对话无缝延续，而 (S2) 点头确认并露出轻微的笑容。
